changes: New: lock the arpeggiator's KEY on single steps of a MIDI track. Hold a trig in ARP SETUP and turn KEY; the step's key holds until the next lock.
Seven modes in all twelve roots: Major, Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Minor and Locrian. The arpeggio keeps running while the key changes.
Move one arp note on a trig: hold it, pick the note with D, shift it by steps of the key with E. The next trig without a setting plays the arpeggio as it is.
While a trig is held, ARP SETUP's KEY box shows its key or its arp note shift.
Known issue: tested on one MKII over USB; not yet on the MKI or as a card build.
